conventions: Item ladder used via ItemStack.useOn(UseOnContext(connection-less ServerPlayer, MAIN_HAND, BlockHitResult(centre of clicked face, face, clicked pos, false))). P=(96,150,96). Player yaw/pitch as Minecraft (yaw 0=south,90=west,180=north,270=east; pitch -60 looks up, +60 down). A rows: [block, yaw, pitch, clicked_face of stone at P, state at P+face or null]. B rows: [block, clicked_block (placed at D+d), d (clicked block is on side d of D, click face = opposite of d, destination D=P), stone cells at D+s, several joined with + (null=none, 5 names = all neighbours except d), yaw, pitch, state at D or null]. D rows: stone at P, ladder[facing=north] at P.north; [yaw, pitch, clicked face of that ladder, state at ladder+face or null]. Stone also at the three horizontal neighbours of P.north.north other than P.north, so a ladder can hang there.
